rationale: The agent executed order-changing writes (exchange and return) without first confirming with the user, violating the stated policy. It also did not present all skateboard options and prices or obtain the user’s choice of the most expensive option before proceeding. The final message provided no details of actions taken or outcomes. Although tools were used to locate the user and retrieve orders, there is no clear, explicit authentication step in the conversation and no confirmation prior to writes. Therefore the request was not completed in line with the policy.
